visual_logic.surface_detail: Broad, square-shaped 'bony shield' with a tactile, weathered stone texture on top and soft, pale-peach skin on the underside, displayed cleanly across its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The broad, extremely flat head with its wide mouth is oriented completely parallel to the frame edge, keeping the small, soulful eye positioned side-on.

environment.water: Shallow, crystalline turquoise water with refractive 'caustics' dancing on the armor, balanced to keep the lateral outline completely measurable.
environment.biota: The white carbonate sand bed, Triassic algae, and small floating crustaceans are shifted entirely into the lowest background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.

pose: The turtle-like placodont is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original stationary resting pose on the sand bed is converted into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its flat skull, box-like armored carapace, short limbs, and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
